newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell completes defense unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell completes defense unit sale.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp said it has completed the sale of its defense and aerospace units to Boeing Co on December 6, 1996.
Boeing will assume $2.2 billion in Rockwell debt and issue about 9.19 million shares of common stock to Rockwell shareholders, valuing the defense and aerospace business about $3.2 billion.
The deal, which was structured to be tax free, entailed the restructuring of Rockwell into its automation, semiconductor systems, avionics and automotive businesses, the company said.
The company will issue new shares of Rockwell, which had pro-forma revenues of more than $10 billion in 1995 excluding the units sold, to reflect the restructuring, it said.
Rockwell's shareholders approved the deal on December 4, 1996.
